avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

lines.label: Road
lines.text: Reports have ended for this season. Traditionally weather and road conditions are reported on this page from November 1 to April 1. Should adverse weather occur that will impact travel, updates will be provided as information is available.

facts.text: Snow left Stevens Pass (3,940 ft) and Fish Lake (3,440 ft) 14 to 15 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: left May 7; earlier seasons: May 21 (2023), May 24 (2024), May 22 (2025)

evidence.name: Fish Lake
evidence.detail: left April 30; earlier seasons: May 16 (2023), May 14 (2024), May 7 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Stevens Pass (3,940 ft) and Fish Lake (3,440 ft).

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: 23.6 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 40.0 in (2023), 30.2 in (2024), 32.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Fish Lake
evidence.detail: 13.2 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 24.6 in (2023), 19.9 in (2024), 16.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 22 and June 19, carried from the melt-out dates at Stevens Pass (3,940 ft) and Fish Lake (3,440 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 7, 752 ft below the pass; points to April 23 to June 16

evidence.name: Fish Lake
evidence.detail: melted out April 30, 1,252 ft below the pass; points to April 21 to June 22
